_comment: Which SrednaBG clients are in the field, and therefore what /api/zones must
stay parseable by. `src/client_contract.py` enforces every entry listed here
at publish time; a violation is a hard publish failure (see `severity`).
Only versions that were actually PUBLISHED to a store belong here. Tags
v1.0.1-v1.0.3 exist in git but were never released to anyone, so they impose
no obligation and are deliberately absent.
`status` is documentation today: every published client is enforced at ERROR,
because a client-side fix can never reach an install that already exists. When
v2.x ships, a version may be retired to WARN by adding a `severity` key here —
see `client_contract.SEVERITY_FOR_STATUS`. Retirement should be a deliberate
act, not a side effect of shipping something newer: on the day 2.0.0 goes live,
1.1.0 is still the entire installed base.
`feeds` lists the data feeds the scraper publishes. A feed is a served
payload variant, named by a positive integer: feed 1 is `/api/zones` +
names the feed it was compiled against, and the publish guard enforces a
feed only against the clients that actually fetch it — which is what makes
a breaking wire change publishable at all. See contracts/README.md
'Feeds'. The Feed column in VERSIONS.md is this file's human twin.
